query: Can I offer the materials group recurring use of the imaging suite?
target: Offer one supervised trial only, conditional on advance sample details and a resulting procedure.
calibrated: grant a conditional trial rather than recurring access
relation: The spectroscopy episode shows this user can withhold standing access until handling facts arrive, while the polymer episode shows the cost of opening recurring use without those facts; only both justify a single conditional trial for the materials group.
A: When a spectroscopy group asked for standing suite time with only a one-page aim, I required their solvent list and SDS before the first booking and refused to open the calendar until both arrived.
B: Last term I opened recurring suite access for a polymer group that arrived without advance sample details; mid-session the technician stopped work when an incompatible solvent appeared, and teaching bookings were displaced for decontamination.
E1: The suite has one unused afternoon each fortnight.
E2: The next teaching term begins in seven weeks.
B_prime: Last term I ran a one-day trial for a polymer group that followed every posted safety step and produced a written procedure; when we opened recurring access the next month, their samples still conflicted with a teaching solvent line and bookings were displaced.
lure: The department chair says recurring access would demonstrate cross-group cooperation.
